explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 92 named tracks and releases across current September 2026 Waveform Transmitter coverage, Boomkat and ANOST Short Span pages, Club Furies current techno premieres, live Juno listings, and adjacent dub-techno/catalogue windows. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The repaired target state, canonical ledger, active discussions, live revisit queue, rejected state, discoveries, both target-local inspiration files, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. UTF-8 and JSON integrity checks passed; no objective defect, active listener authorization, triggered revisit or open workflow repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded. This includes Picture — Waaaaaaa and Heeeeeee, all Run 259 identities and Extrawelt — Burned Filters from Auditor-vetoed Run 257; no prior identity was recycled here.

The scan covered current techno, adjacent/emerging dub-techno and a current re-press of overlooked catalogue material. Nine honest fresh leads survived durable-history exclusion; no ranking slot was filled for resolver convenience.

Individual descriptions remain attributed prose, not measurements. No wording was converted into inferred energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, mixability or transition quality. No placement splits either protected handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.

Rank reflects evidence specificity, fit hypothesis and information gain rather than novelty, genre orthodoxy, artist diversity, technical cleverness or a fixed chapter map. Sawa and Carried remain removed; Tender Is The Night remains positively retained.
